title: SCAFFOLD under Hessian Similarity: Sharp Convergence Rates
abstract: arXiv:2610.35663v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: One of the main challenges of federated learning is heterogeneous data split among the clients, leading to biased local updates called client drift. The SCAFFOLD algorithm (Karimireddy et al., 2020) corrects client drift with control variates, but its relation to the similarity of client data is not yet fully understood: the original similarity-based guarantees cover only quadratics with a stronger second-order similarity assumption, and a follow-up weakly convex analysis (Luo et al., 2025) obtains a $\sqrt{L\delta}$ dependence for $L$-smooth losses with averaged Hessian similarity $\delta$. We analyze SCAFFOLD with minibatch-based control variates and establish linear dependence on Hessian similarity beyond quadratics, for both convex and nonconvex objectives. translated_title: Hessian相似性下的SCAFFOLD：精确收敛速率
translated_abstract: 联邦学习的主要挑战之一是客户端之间的数据异构性，它会导致有偏的本地更新，即所谓的客户端漂移。SCAFFOLD算法（Karimireddy等人，2020）通过控制变量来纠正客户端漂移，但其与客户端数据相似性之间的关系尚未被完全理解：原始的基于相似性的保证仅覆盖具有更强二阶相似性假设的二次函数，而后续的弱凸分析（Luo等人，2025）对于具有平均Hessian相似性δ的L-光滑损失得到了$\sqrt{L\delta}$量级的依赖。我们分析了采用基于小批量的控制变量的SCAFFOLD算法，并在二次函数之外——同时针对凸与非凸目标函数——建立了对Hessian相似性的线性依赖关系。特别地，对于具有精确梯度的凸目标函数，R轮SCAFFOLD配合每轮K步本地更新可达到量级为$(L/K+\delta)D_0^2/R$的目标函数间隙，其中$D_0$为初始……
tldr: 本文证明了SCAFFOLD算法在Hessian相似性条件下对相似性参数δ的收敛速率具有线性依赖（改进了此前$\sqrt{L\delta}$的依赖），且该结论超越了二次函数情形，同时适用于凸和非凸目标。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes sharp convergence rates for SCAFFOLD with linear dependence on Hessian similarity δ—improving upon prior $\sqrt{L\delta}$ bounds—beyond quadratic objectives and for both convex and nonconvex settings.
